agents.name: Rex
agents.note:
US-502 DONE (Sprint 69 / V0.29.24, 2/10). The System-Status power tile + header bolt now read the real AC/battery source. ROOT was as groomed: the tile read PowerMonitor.readPowerStatus(), whose reader is NEVER configured in the orchestrator -- so source was permanently 'unknown', the tile rendered its 'unavailable' branch and the bolt stayed gray, while the real GPIO6 fact was already flowing to power_log via the B1 _PowerSourceUiBridge. _gatherPowerSource now reads PowerSourceProvider direct and PowerMonitor is REMOVED from that path (a second acquisition path could disagree with GPIO6 = the SSOT violation the design gate forbids). AC4 SEAM-CONFIRM did not need a wait: architecture.md SS-T4 already rules 'UI and ShutdownSequencer both consume this one provider, differ only by policy' -- the UI half was simply never built, so this completes the specified seam. A2AL note filed to Atlas for the one contract delta; conditionalOutcomes make the DoD 'tile reflects the real source', so a NAK costs a re-point, not a rebuild. THE ONE CALL THE PM SHOULD KNOW ABOUT: the only contract change is a new PowerSourceProvider.isAvailable property, and it exists because the shutdown path's safe direction is a LIE on a display. An unreadable PLD deliberately answers isExternalPowerPresent()==True (never self-brick on a dead signal); taking that at face value on the tile paints a confident lit-green 'external' off a DEAD GPIO -- strictly worse than the gray bolt the story exists to fix. So the provider exposes the FACT (is the line readable) and each consumer keeps its OWN uncertainty policy: sequencer=treat-as-present, UI=unknown. isExternalPowerPresent/isPowerLost/startupArmCheck untouched -> the shutdown path provably did not move. ALT-REJECTED: a provider returning a display-shaped tri-state = policy inside the SSOT. SECOND TRAP, same shape as US-501's stale .deploy-version cache: the provider is built in _startHardwareManager (lifecycle.py:2251) but the card emitters are built EARLIER in _initializeAllComponents -- a reference captured at emitter-init would be None for the life of the process = permanently dead tile with fully green tests. Read is lazy, per emit. 17 tests, 5 mutations all caught (drop the isAvailable gate / vocab drift external->ac / capture-at-init / drop the exception guard / re-add the PowerMonitor path). Chain pinned END-TO-END, not per-half: tests/ui/test_carousel_power_source_wiring.py drives the REAL emitter -> REAL state file -> REAL carousel.js powerTile+powerGlyphState under node, because both halves were already individually correct and simply did not agree -- the exact failure a per-half test stays green through (US-494/US-499 lesson). Green in-loop: tests/pi/orchestrator + tests/pi/power + the carousel chain = 255 passed exit 0, the 17 new ones verified RUN not skipped (node present); ruff clean on all 6 touched files. Architecture DoD met in-sprint (section 2, 'UI consumer wired (US-502)'). FLAG FOR PM: card_state_emitter.py is a base-module touch -- prioritise the full-suite regression + mypy at integration (not run in-loop per TD-059). OWED: the on-Pi read of the bolt + tile on wall/bench power -- PM/CIO drill, not codeable. Next up is US-503 (12-hour AM/PM idle clock, S).

PRIOR (US-501, same sprint): dashboard header version chip wired to .deploy-version via a __DEPLOY_VERSION__ placeholder substituted in states_http_server._injectHtml, alongside the existing __SPLASH_TOKEN__ / __DISPLAY_AUTODIM__ / __DISPLAY_CAROUSEL__ seams. Read PER REQUEST, not cached at handler construction: deploy-pi.sh restarts eclipse-states-http (line 1939) but stamps .deploy-version LAST (line 1955), deliberately per US-354, so a start-time cache renders the PREVIOUS deploy's version on EVERY deploy -- green tests, correct-looking code, and the exact stale literal the story deletes. Honest degrade: readDeployVersion returns None (never a guess) for no-path / absent / unreadable / malformed / missing / blank / non-string, and the chip falls back to the SAME 'V?.?.?' sentinel the splash uses. NO deploy or unit-file change needed (--deploy-version-path defaults WorkingDirectory-relative). 18 tests; CAVEAT for Iris: a file:// preview shows raw __DEPLOY_VERSION__ in the chip -- the quoted-placeholder trick does not work on HTML text content; deliberate, dev-only. OWED: the on-Pi chip read after deploy.
